entities.name: Back-off timer value
entities.description: An optional information element that the network may include to request a minimum time interval before procedure retry is allowed.

entities.name: ESM cause exclusion condition
entities.description: Condition where the ESM cause is not one of the specified values (#28, #50, #51, #54, #57, #58, #61, #65) that would prevent inclusion of the back-off timer value IE.

entities.name: Procedure retry delay
entities.description: Property indicating a minimum time interval must elapse before a procedure retry is allowed.

relations.description: The inclusion of the back-off timer value IE is guarded by the condition that the ESM cause is not one of the excluded values.
The back-off timer value IE establishes a minimum time interval property before procedure retry is allowed.
